turns.question: How many MQLs did paid social bring in during September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for MQLs (marketing-qualified leads): leads carry no qualification status, so I cannot give an MQL count for paid social in September 2026. The closest metrics are Leads (leads, CRM leads created, which can be filtered to campaign__channel = social), Lead-to-booking rate (lead_to_booking_rate) and Bookings (bookings); tell me if you want social leads for September 2026 instead.
